    (h_eq : p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2) :

        use 3 * p

        cases h_or with
        | inl h_and =>
            rcases h_and with ⟨hp, hq⟩

            use 19
            norm_num
        | inr h_and =>
            rcases h_and with ⟨hp, hq⟩
            rw [hp, hq]
            use 19

/-- If p² + 7pq + q² = m² and p ≠ q, then m ≤ p + q + 2 -/

lemma helper_m_plus_one_constraint (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (h_neq : p ≠ q) (m : ℕ) (h_eq : p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2) (h_m : m = p + q + 1) :
    5 * p * q = 2 * p + 2 * q + 1 := by nlinarith
